in_marathi.name: Vickram
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Brave, Strong, Victor
in_marathi.long_meaning: Vickram हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Vickram is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Vikrama', which means 'to be strong', 'brave', or 'valiant'. It is a name that symbolizes strength, courage, and victory over adversity. In Hindu mythology, Vickram is also the name of a king who was known for his courage and just rule.
